message.content:
This editorial illustration for Tempo magazine, dated 14-20 MARET 2022, features a dense crowd of stylized human figures gathered around a large, purple, spherical object with multiple protruding protein spikes. The central sphere, resting on the ground, is textured with small circular bumps. In the foreground, four figures stand behind the sphere: two in light blue full-body protective suits with face shields and masks, a man in a white button-down shirt and glasses, and a man in a white long-sleeved shirt and red trousers.

Surrounding them is a diverse crowd including a person in academic regalia holding a scroll, a person in a green jacket with a black helmet, and a young person in a school uniform with a red cap. The background is filled with layered figures representing various professions and styles, some wearing hats like a conical straw hat, a police cap, or a beret.

Large red letters spell "TEMPO" across the top. White text at the bottom reads "TERPAKSA HIDUP BERSAMA CORONA". Below this, smaller text reads: "Pemerintah bersiap mengubah status pandemi Covid-19 menjadi endemi di tengah naiknya tingkat kematian dan vaksinasi yang rendah. Apa saja skenarionya? H.30". Additional headlines appear at the top.
